mentions.name: Reform of American English (RAEA)
mentions.description: A proposed total reform of American English spelling, currently around 90% complete, documented on a webpage with a linked PDF explaining the system in full (charts on pages 4, 5, and 7 suffice for reading it). Alice in Wonderland and Dr Jekyll are fully transcribed into the reformed system as working examples, and the author invites thoughts, complaints, and feedback on the system.
